description: Canonical, GID and Int64 round trips for every level 0..14, plus rejected inputs.

invalid_gids.reason: lowercase is not a V2 GID
I is outside the base-5 alphabet
v1 10 km style value; 7 is not valid at level 6 (base 2)
Z is outside the base-5 alphabet at level 9
level 15 is above the maximum of 14

invalid_packed_ids.reason: level 15 is above the maximum of 14
unused path bits set at level 1

packed_ids_by_domain.description: The same cells packed under every domain. GIDs and indices do not depend on the domain, so only the domain bits of each packed_ids value change.
